name: Per-input, per-scored-bit conditional-mask transfer
kind: conditional theorem companion; completed certificate unchanged
projection: An original output bit covered by the audited equivalence. Value filtering uses original scored coordinate bits; added private flags are excluded.

notation.x: A fixed original ABI input; final candidate Fiat inputs must be computed from the final candidate source/stream.
notation.b: A bit in the audited original output projection.
notation.r: An arbitrary assignment to all original MR events.
notation.s: An arbitrary assignment to all candidate MR events, including added private cache MR.
notation.pi: The audited projection of candidate MR assignments onto preserved original MR events.
notation.F_b: The original frozen function's output bit.
notation.G_b: The audited candidate's corresponding output bit.

certified_equivalence: For every x and s, G_b(x,s) = F_b(x,pi(s)).
separate_per_input_premise: For the fixed x and b, F_b(x,r) is constant for every original MR assignment r.
conclusion: For the fixed x and b, for every candidate MR assignment s, G_b(x,s) = F_b(x,0).
proof: Substitute r=pi(s) into the per-input constant-bit premise. The same constant equals F_b(x,0). The completed equivalence covers arbitrary added cache MR assignments.
safe_rejection_rule: On final candidate Fiat inputs x, reject when an independently certified constant bit's original zero-MR value disagrees with the expected curve bit. Matching masked bits or an empty mask does not establish a pass; full simulation remains required for survivors.

new_nonce_requirements.tail_identity: Exactly48 adjacent XX identity pairs on the authorized qubits; no additional functional change.
new_nonce_requirements.Fiat_inputs: Derive from the actual final nonce candidate source/stream; never reuse old source inputs or packets.
new_nonce_requirements.qualification: Existing fresh failure-census, nonce disclosure and unchanged full benchmark rules still apply.

trusted_base: Exactly the frozen certificate's conservative immutable Boolean kernels and HMR/CZ gadget theorem, plus the separately established per-input mask and source-bound zero-MR evaluator premises. No sampled replay or heuristic mask substitutes for those premises.
